close_reason: Decomposed into 7 per-sibling child beads (.7.1 through .7.7), one per extension-server sibling crate (chat, calendars, tasks, contacts, filenode, sharing, metadata). Each child carries the specific 6-pattern sweep list with cross-references to the mail-server commits that landed the canonical fix. The children join the autonomous frontier; closing this orchestration bead so it doesn't permanently block the ready queue. Sibling-propagation notes I left earlier (q2wa.18, .16, .15) are preserved in this bead's comment history for context.
description:
jmap-mail-server is the canonical extension-server template (workspace AGENTS.md "Canonical Templates"). The findings in this review epic — particularly the Pattern G regressions, server_fail_from_backend misses, and the silent-drop-on-non-string bug — all need a propagation pass to chat-server, calendars-server, tasks-server, contacts-server, filenode-server, sharing-server (and metadata-server, sieve-server when those land).

The sibling check is mandatory under the propagation rule: 'If you change this crate, propagate the change to every extension-server sibling in the same pass (or file a follow-up sweep bead before merging).'

This bead is the follow-up sweep marker. When the P0/P1 findings in this epic are addressed, add the sibling-equivalent fixes (or document why they don't apply, e.g. apply_header_form is mail-specific) before closing.

Specific siblings to check:
- Pattern G unwrap_or(Value::Null): scan every */sibling-server/src/*.rs for the antipattern
- server_fail leak: grep for 'JmapError::server_fail(e.to_string())' across all siblings
- silent-drop on non-string property: identify all */sibling-server set handlers' build_*_from_props equivalents and audit their non-string handling
- filter-roundtrip silent fallback: check sibling memory.rs files for the same .ok().and_then(.ok()) pattern
title: Cookie-cutter propagation: P0 P1 findings must be checked against 6 sibling extension-server crates
